title: Improving Language Models Trained on Translated Data with Continual Pre-Training and Dictionary Learning Analysis

bias_targets.methodology: Token Set Enrichment Analysis (TSEA) using Sparse Auto-Encoders (SAEs) to compare model feature activations on predefined sets of 600 common English versus Arabic first names.

Token Set Enrichment Analysis (TSEA) to examine feature activations on differing language-specific grammatical structures and dialog tagging templates (e.g., quote placement relative to the speaker's name).
